Your Genetic Wound
47.5
The Wound of Guilt

When the bearer of this Wound shares their feelings with a loved one, they often pose as a victim of circumstances or blame the other person for their high expectations and attempt to shift their problems onto other person. The theme of unrealised projections and mutual expectations is particularly evident here.

Defensive Reaction:

In the repressive form, this Trauma makes a person feel guilty for not living up to the expectations of others. In the reactive form, a person starts blaming others for all their problems.

Way of Healing:
Forgiveness / Letting Go

To transform the Fifth Wound, you need to learn to forgive yourself and others. No one has to live up to your expectations, but neither do you always have to live up to hopes or expectations of other people. Forgive yourself for that! You are what you are! And you are beautiful! A Wound is your unconscious reaction, so you have to work deeply with it through the body.

Learn to notice when you start to feel guilty. At the level of the physical body, guilt is manifested by the vibration of fear, between the chest and abdomen. It is important to just start feeling the vibrations of fear in your body, but not to become a victim of it.

Emotional Reaction to the Manifestation of Wound
47.1
Self-Sabotage

It is important to be honest with yourself about how you feel about yourself. Do not take the blame for the situation, go within and realise that there is nothing wrong with you.

At low frequencies, it manifests itself as a Shadow: Low Self-Esteem. An inner conviction that other people are better than you and there is something wrong with you.

At high frequencies, it turns into a Gift: Sustained Self-Esteem. Self-love combined with a willingness to surrender to life in all its manifestations.

Practical Guidelines for Working through Wound

By becoming aware of the motives of what is happening and forgiving other people for their most terrible or ugly actions, you learn to forgive and accept yourself. As a result, bearers of this Wound are capable of becoming the most compassionate and soulful leaders in the world! When the Wound of Guilt is transformed, you will be able to discover your talent as a great facilitator and manager.
